body.heading: Where in the world is Uruguay?
paragraphs: Uruguay is a country in South America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Uruguay is Montevideo.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Uruguay is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Uruguay is the Uruguayan peso.

body.heading: How big is Uruguay?
paragraphs: Uruguay covers about 181,000 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Colonia is a 17th-century Portuguese-Spanish old town of cobbles, vintage cars and a lighthouse, just across the river from Buenos Aires.
Punta del Este is Uruguay's beloved beach resort — the giant hand sculpture rising from the sand and the white maze of Casa Pueblo nearby.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Uruguay on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Uruguay in one breath: a country in South America, capital Montevideo, where people speak Spanish and pay with the Uruguayan peso.
